title: Her version
rule: The stranger tells it later to a fellow passenger on the train: chatty captions in her voice, over pictures of what she saw.
declares: E4-E5 told as she imagines them
made: the narrator cut from Rol 34852 (GrabCut with hand-drawn scissor paths, the hat forced in by a drawn path), white scissor margin
the listener: Rol 49112 cutout reused from exercices-de-style (forage/man_rgba.png)
band picture: Rol 1933 carriage interior, cropped inside the plate edge, printed with a white border
six prints of what she saw recomposed from the 99-ways-template rest layers (P1, P4, P5, P3, P7, P8) without the old balloons; one sepia grade (7 %) for every photograph on the page
E4 and E5 printed faint with a pencilled dashed edge and 'as I picture it' (declared: told as she imagines them)

caption slips in her voice, the four canonical lines in the shared cut-paper balloons inside the prints (her own two tailed out of the print toward her), her opening line and the listener's 'Do tell!' in the band
cover grammar: butter ground, warm grey band, jumping red/black cover line lettered letter by letter in the shared pen hand (no font)

events.E0: P1: There he sat at his desk, frowning at some slip of paper. Up he gets.
events.E1: P4: Well, my watch had stopped, so I tapped on his glass, polite as you please: | balloon: Pardon me — have you the right time?
events.E2: P5: He squints round at that big clock of his and says: | balloon: Ten past four, by the clock.
events.E3: P3: So I thanked him, and off he went the other way. | balloon: Much obliged!
events.E4: P7: Now I couldn't see, mind you, but I'll wager he went and opened his cupboard...
events.E5: P8: ...and stood there like a post, pencil on his chin! That SERVICE door never did open. | balloon: Well, here I am... and what for?

lines.question: Pardon me — have you the right time?
lines.answer: Ten past four, by the clock.
lines.forgetting: Well, here I am... and what for?

added_lines.STRANGER (later, on the train): You'll never guess what I saw at Randolph today!
